records.process_description: This unit supervises Bachelor theses for students in the Filmwissenschaft Major (120 ECTS). Choose a realistic film‑scholarship topic early, contact a prüfungsberechtigte Betreuungsperson (professors, postdocs, Oberassistierende or Privatdozierende listed on the FIWI team page), send an idea sketch and arrange a meeting before booking the “Bachelorarbeit” module; timing of the booking is agreed with the supervisor. Work proceeds via a concept phase (short concept, max ~5 pages with summary, question, theory, thesis, method, provisional structure, bibliography/filmography), a writing phase (allow ≥1 month for first draft and ≥2 weeks for revision) and final submission to the supervisor within the deadline. Formals: 35–40 pages (70’000–80’000 characters), normally in German (English/French by agreement). Official guidelines and templates: FIWI Download/Bildung (Studium) and the Faculty module page (https://www.phil.uzh.ch/de/studium/rundumsstudium/module.html).
